final_face_line: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): oval face, balanced length, medium width; soft rounded jaw; narrow eyes, medium size, level outer corners, average spacing; straight medium brows; broad low bridge nose; wide mouth.

casual_plan.scene: In a small personal pottery studio on a rainy afternoon, smoothing a clay bowl on a stationary workbench with two separate hands, no spinning wheel. Warm task lamp, misted window and simple ceramic shelves. Both hands fully visible and naturally attached to forearms.
casual_plan.outfit: Opaque burnt-orange halter-neck linen top with a short dark-blue waist apron over high-waisted beige shorts, small black angular stud earrings; bare shoulders arms and a small midriff.
casual_plan.camera: 1024x1536 vertical, waist-up eye-level portrait; both hands and bowl fully in crop.
casual_plan.custom: Same adult woman as the approved light reference. Remove armor, fin crest and gill ornaments. Only tiny angular jewelry echoes her species.

casual_plan.scene: On an empty wooden tide-pool deck at sunset, sitting on a low bench with one knee raised slightly and both feet naturally visible, one open hand on the raised knee and the other on the bench beside her. Rocky cove and calm sea, amber backlight.
casual_plan.outfit: Opaque dark-blue one-piece swimsuit with orange side panels and secure high neckline, a light cream short sarong tied at the hip, barefoot, small black fin pendant; bare shoulders arms and legs.
casual_plan.camera: 1024x1536 vertical, entire seated figure including both complete hands and both bare feet, eye-level three-quarter view.
casual_plan.custom: Same adult woman as the approved light reference. Remove armor, fin crest and gill ornaments. Only tiny angular jewelry echoes her species.

casual_plan.scene: Walking past an empty urban bicycle-repair courtyard at blue hour after a ride, carrying a plain lightweight cycling helmet in her right hand at hip level while left hand hangs separately. Warm workshop windows and parked bicycles in background, no writing or people.
casual_plan.outfit: Opaque orange sleeveless zip-front cycling jersey with dark-blue side panels and short fitted black cycling shorts, simple trainers, a tiny angular earring; bare arms and legs, functional sports clothing.
casual_plan.camera: 1024x1536 vertical, knee-up side profile with her face turned toward camera, both complete hands and helmet inside crop.
casual_plan.custom: Same adult woman as the approved light reference. Remove armor, fin crest and gill ornaments. Only tiny angular jewelry echoes her species.
